_comment: Actions, per GDD §3's rule that everything is data. Costed in MOMENTUM (momentum.js), which means they are paid for by MOVING — you run in, then spend the run. That is the loop this game took from Metal Slug Tactics, and until v25 there was nothing to spend it on but a flat damage bonus. An ability replaces a unit's normal attack; it never grants a second action. `role` decides who gets it, so the whole 14-strong cast is covered without hand-authoring 28 entries, and a per-unit `abilities` override stays a one-line addition. Enemies deliberately have none: their variety is `behaviour` (ai.js), and giving both sides kits would make a telegraph nobody can read. `damageMode` says whether `damage` is a BONUS on top of the weapon ("weapon") or the whole number ("flat") — Shove is flat because a shove is a shove whoever is holding the pipe. `accuracy` REPLACES the weapon's hit chance outright (Shove: 1, it never misses); `accuracyMod` shifts it (Snap Shot: -0.15). They are different fields because conflating them once already turned a 70% ability into a 5% one.

abilities.name: Cleave
abilities.blurb: Weapon damage to EVERY adjacent rival. Being surrounded stops being a death sentence and starts being an opportunity.

abilities.name: Takedown
abilities.blurb: +3 damage and a hard shove on one adjacent rival. The full-move finisher — and the shove is what puts a body in a stairwell.

abilities.name: Snap Shot
abilities.blurb: Two shots at one rival, each less accurate. Volume against a target you cannot afford to leave standing.

abilities.name: Overwatch
abilities.blurb: Hold your fire. The first rival to move inside your range during their turn takes a shot — the answer to a board where crossing open ground was free.

abilities.name: Shove
abilities.blurb: One damage, three tiles, never misses. Pure positioning: the cheapest way to move a body onto something that hurts.

abilities.name: Barricade
abilities.blurb: Drop low cover on an empty tile beside you. The only thing in this game that changes the board in your favour.
